verdict.rationale: PostHog's CDP (Customer Data Pipeline) docs explicitly describe pulling data in and sending it 'wherever it needs to go' via configurable Hog function pipelines/destinations, in realtime or on schedule, covering webhooks and third-party destinations. missing for 10: an explicit named list of specific CRM/ad-platform destinations (e.g. Salesforce, Google Ads) in the pack, and independent/hands-on confirmation of destination delivery reliability.
